title: VTA Witness — Accept — payload
description: A client hands its VTA the witness's answer to the submission; the VTA verifies the Verifiable Witness Credential it carries against the session, and stores it in the credential vault with its evidence.

response.description: The witness/session/submit/0.2 #response the witness returned, exactly as received, under the witness's proof. It carries the VWC and its vwcDigestMultibase.

Response.title: VTA Witness — Accept — response payload
Response.description: The stored VWC's vault handle, its digest, and the evidence documents that carry it. Sent only once the VWC is verified and stored.

credentialId.description: The credential-vault handle the VWC is now stored under, with its evidence.

witness.description: The witness that issued the VWC: the session's witness, since a VWC issued by any other party is refused, not stored.

vwcDigestMultibase.description: The digest the witness returned for the VWC, which the VTA has checked against the VWC it stored: over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of the VWC, proof included.

evidence.description: The two documents a holder ships with the VWC so a verifier can pair it with the session that produced it: `session`, the witness/session/0.2 document as the VTA built it, and `outcome`, the witness/session/submit/0.2 #response as received, which carries the VWC. Each is carried exactly as sent or received, never re-serialised.
